svg.text: · pipeline.py names the airline in 4 imports and 4 construction sites. A second domain has no seam to plug into — the pipeline itself would have to be copied.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: · One internal tool is defined in three independent places: the _dispatch_tool_call if/elif chain, _READ_ONLY_TOOLS, and the "Available internal tools:" prose in the thinker prompt.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: · airline/thinker.py has no overall deadline, no planner deadline and no stale-generation guard: a superseded call can still deliver a late payload.
